name: com.decionis/commerce-gate
title: Decionis CommerceGate MCP
description: Commerce preflights, D365 authorization, signed evidence, and reports; no marketplace or ERP writes.

environmentVariables.name: DECIONIS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Existing workspace key. Unconfigured local STDIO can create provisional Shadow access on first evaluation; owned access is required for ERP.

environmentVariables.name: DECIONIS_ORG_ID
environmentVariables.description: Organization UUID that binds Protocol evaluation and evidence calls. The ERP guard instead authenticates request.tenant_id with the configured API key.

environmentVariables.name: DECIONIS_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTPS API origin or exact /aws gateway prefix. Defaults to https://api.decionis.com.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTOPS_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Optional private directory for persistent local trial credentials; defaults to ~/.config/agentops (honoring XDG_CONFIG_HOME).

environmentVariables.name: AGENTOPS_AUTO_PROVISION
environmentVariables.description: Set 0 to disable new local trial creation. Existing stored credentials remain usable.
